title: Telemetry-driven holdpoints and autofallbacks for Hosted API pipeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Context: Recent regional rollouts and blue/green swaps exposed gaps where automated traffic shifts completed despite transient backend degradations (KV cache churn, cold-start spikes). We need a pipeline-level guard that (1) evaluates live telemetry during staged regional rollouts and blue/green swaps, (2) enforces holdpoints when SLO regressions or signal anomalies are detected, and (3) triggers safe autofallbacks or rollback when holdpoints exceed thresholds. This ticket implements telemetry-driven holdpoints and a deterministic autofallback controller for the Hosted API deployment pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Holdpoint operator integrated into the existing rollout controller and can pause an ongoing rollout based on telemetry rules
Telemetry rules support error-rate, latency (p50/p95/p99), token-level cost spike, and cache-miss ratio; thresholds are configurable per release channel
Autofallback executes a safe, rate-limited rollback or traffic diversion to previous LTS variant with KV warmup policy
Event and decision traces emitted to Console (trace id + reason) and an on-call Slack channel; traces link to dashboards and PRs
End-to-end test harness that simulates a regional latency spike and validates holdpoint + autofallback behavior
implementation_plan: Design telemetry schema and standardize metric names (metrics/ tags) with Observability team
Add Holdpoint CRD to rollout controller: rules + evaluation window + mitigation action
Implement evaluator component: sliding-window aggregator, anomaly detection heuristics, and SLO comparator
Hook into traffic-shift engine: pause/resume API and a deterministic autofallback path that drains traffic by weight over 60s
Integrate KV-cache warmup step that pre-populates caches on target variant before final cutover
Add Console UI indicators for held rollouts, including decision rationale and replay link
Create chaos-style integration tests that inject latency/error and verify safe behavior
Ship feature gated behind runtime-1.19 and enable for internal org first, then progressively for customers
risks_and_mitigation: False positives from noisy metrics => use multi-signal voting (error-rate + p99 + cache-miss) and require sustained window
Late detection can still surface customer impact => tighten pre-rollout canary and reduce initial cutover weight
Autofallback could oscillate if underlying issue persists => add cooldown windows and circuit-breaker per region
Operator bugs could block rollouts => add manual override + audit log for every decision
KV warmup may be slow for large models => use parallelized prefix-warm and instrument progress metrics

notes: Operator behavior: evaluate 30s windows with 3-window grace (configurable). Require >=2 signals breaching thresholds to trigger holdpoint
Autofallback policy: 60s phased weight shift back to source variant, KV warmup concurrency 8, followed by health stable window of 120s before marking rollback complete
Release channels: promoted behavior differs by channel: LTS channels have stricter thresholds and require manual approval for autofallback; non-LTS allow automated fallback
Metrics retention: store recent 5 minutes at 1s granularity for rapid evaluation; aggregate into 1m buckets for dashboarding
Observability hooks: emit decision event with fields [release, region, rule, metrics_snapshot, action, decision_trace_url]
